title: Dakhni.org page
description: Content file schema for dakhni.org static site pages.

references.description: Bibliography for this page. Every id must be cited at least once in the content, either via a <cite data-ref="id"></cite> marker inside an html/section/timeline block, or via a facts item's 'ref' field.

link_terms.description: Exact-phrase names for this page (its title and natural variants). Any of these phrases found as plain text on another page is auto-linked to this page's url, once per page.

no_subnav.description: If true, this page is excluded from the auto Prev/Next subnav entirely: it gets no subnav of its own, and it is never listed as a sibling in its parent's subnav group. For sub-topic leaf pages that share a URL prefix with unrelated sibling pages but shouldn't join their Prev/Next tour.

nested_hub.description: If true, this page keeps its own Prev/Next entry in its parent's subnav group even though its URL is itself the parent of other pages (which would otherwise exclude it, as with a pure listing hub). For a contentful page that is both a normal sibling in its own parent's tour and a hub for its own nested children, e.g. a heritage pillar page that hosts named-topic sub-pages under its own URL.

redirect_from.description: Old URLs this page used to live at, e.g. because its URL was later changed. A small static redirect stub (meta refresh + canonical, noindex) is written at each old URL, pointing at this page's current url -- so a moved page's previously published address doesn't 404 for bookmarks or already-indexed search results.
